title: [opencode-zen-free] free flash models return finish_reason=tool_calls with an empty tool_calls array; tooling clients stall (GLM-5.3-flash-free, DeepSeek-V4.1-flash-free)
body:
## Versions

- Magpie app: `0.1.1559` at time of the occurrences (occurrences spanned several same-day auto-updates on 2026-10-26). Latest at filing: `v0.1.1564` (2026-10-26) — **not yet confirmed whether this is fixed in 1562–1564**.
- Plugin: `@magpie-community/opencode-zen-free-auth@0.1.15` (latest as of 2026-10-25).

## Environment

- Provider: `opencode-zen-free` (OpenCode Zen free tier, `https://opencode.ai/inference/v1`), keyless (`public`).
- Models: `opencode-zen-free/glm-5.3-flash-free:max`, `opencode-zen-free/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free:max`.
- Client: Hermes Agent — OpenAI Chat Completions surface, streaming, loopback gateway `127.0.0.1:3425`, served through a Magpie weight-routing group.
- Context at failure: ~73K–131K prompt tokens (both models are catalogued with a 200K context, so this is within the window, not an overflow).

## Symptom

The client intermittently receives an assistant turn whose `finish_reason` is `tool_calls` but whose `tool_calls` array is empty and whose content is not usable. Hermes log line (verbatim):

```
finish_reason=tool_calls with empty tool_calls array (narration only) — re-prompting to emit the call (retry 1/3, model=group/hermes-route provider=custom)
```

Hermes must drop the turn and re-prompt. 11 occurrences in one session on 2026-10-26; zero on any other day. No data loss (the retry succeeds).

## Two observed sub-shapes (from the per-request log at `~/.config/magpie/routing/<date>.jsonl`)

### 1. Billed-but-empty (5 of 11)

`status: 200`, `out` = 42–160 completion tokens were billed, the reply arrived as a single chunk (`flow: 1`), with **no** `firstText` and **no** `firstReasoning` — i.e. the model produced output tokens but delivered nothing as text, reasoning, or a usable `tool_calls`. Same shape as #3327 ("the model wrote a tool call that the parser could not turn into one, so it dropped it; Magpie relays it as a finished turn"). Verbatim rows:

```json
{"time":"2026-10-26T10:00:07.190+08:00","model":"group/hermes-route","served":"glm-5.3-flash-free","provider":"opencode-zen-free","status":200,"out":56,"flow":1,"ttft":4902,"usage":[{"provider":"opencode-zen-free","model":"glm-5.3-flash-free","in":73910,"out":56}],"rule":{"n":0,"turn":10,"tokens":77293,"effort":"xhigh"}}
{"time":"2026-10-26T10:04:44.383+08:00","model":"group/hermes-route","served":"glm-5.3-flash-free","provider":"opencode-zen-free","status":200,"out":42,"flow":1,"ttft":2453,"usage":[{"provider":"opencode-zen-free","model":"glm-5.3-flash-free","in":1807,"out":42,"cache_read":73984}],"rule":{"n":0,"turn":12,"tokens":79209,"effort":"xhigh"}}
{"time":"2026-10-26T10:22:42.616+08:00","model":"group/hermes-route","served":"deepseek-v4.1-flash-free","provider":"opencode-zen-free","status":200,"out":160,"flow":1,"ttft":1948,"usage":[{"provider":"opencode-zen-free","model":"deepseek-v4.1-flash-free","in":164,"out":160,"cache_read":73472}],"rule":{"n":0,"turn":11,"tokens":73148,"effort":"xhigh"}}
{"time":"2026-10-26T11:47:15.442+08:00","model":"group/hermes-route","served":"glm-5.3-flash-free","provider":"opencode-zen-free","status":200,"out":96,"flow":1,"ttft":3796,"usage":[{"provider":"opencode-zen-free","model":"glm-5.3-flash-free","in":2851,"out":96,"cache_read":101184}],"rule":{"n":0,"turn":14,"tokens":106731,"effort":"xhigh"}}
{"time":"2026-10-26T11:53:31.215+08:00","model":"group/hermes-route","served":"glm-5.3-flash-free","provider":"opencode-zen-free","status":200,"out":86,"flow":1,"ttft":3731,"usage":[{"provider":"opencode-zen-free","model":"glm-5.3-flash-free","in":1024,"out":86,"cache_read":125120}],"rule":{"n":0,"turn":16,"tokens":130910,"effort":"xhigh"}}
```

### 2. Narration + phantom finish flag (6 of 11)

Text/reasoning streams normally for 2–7s, yet the turn still ends with `finish_reason=tool_calls` and an empty `tool_calls` array — the model narrates an intended call but sets the flag without a payload. Matches #636 ("never emit finish_reason=tool_calls without delivering the corresponding calls").

## Repro attempt (negative) — the relay path is not systematically broken

Through the gateway, 12 clean non-streaming requests to both models with a forced tool call, at ~3K and ~60K context: **12/12** returned well-formed structured `tool_calls` with correct `id` (e.g. glm `62d6f350-…`, deepseek `call_00_…`). So the failures are intermittent and task-state-dependent (complex multi-turn sessions), not a consistent drop.

## What this is not

- Not a Hermes/client bug: the client detects the empty array and re-prompts correctly.
- Not a systematic gateway drop: proven by the 12/12 control probe above.

## Request

`emptyFails` / empty-turn retry is (per #3327) limited to Gemini and Code Assist. Extend it to Chat-surface free models — at minimum `opencode-zen-free/glm-5.3-flash-free` and `opencode-zen-free/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free` — so a reply with `finish_reason=tool_calls` and an empty array (or `out>0` with no content/tool_calls delivered) is retried / failed over instead of being relayed to the agent as a finished turn. Separately, when the `tool_calls` array is empty the `finish_reason` should be reported as `stop`, so a tooling client isn't misled into discarding a turn that actually just has narration.

## Related

- #3327 (GLM-5.3-flash tool turns end empty and are relayed as finished)
- #636 (`finish_reason=tool_calls` reported with no calls delivered)
- #2611 (empty-`id` streamed tool calls relayed as-is — related empty-tool-call relay class)
